hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) if command -v goimports >/dev/null; then goimports -w "$f"; else gofmt -w "$f"; fi; if command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null; then golangci-lint fmt "$f"; fi;; esac; } 2>&1 || true

statusLine.command: jq -r '(.effort.level // "" | if . == "" then "" else " " + . end) as $eff | (.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at | if . then strflocaltime(" (%H:%M)") else "" end) as $t5 | (.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at | if . then strflocaltime(" (%a %H:%M)") else "" end) as $t7 | ((.cost.total_cost_usd // 0) * 100 | round / 100) as $cost | "[\(.model.display_name)\($eff)] ctx: \(.context_window.remaining_percentage // 100 | floor)% left | 5h: \(100 - (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // 0) | floor)% left\($t5) | 7d: \(100 - (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // 0) | floor)% left\($t7) | $\($cost)"'
